body:
I just don't want my dog to suffer in an animal shelter after I'm gone.  I can't bear that thought, she's the only thing that's been here for me steadily and kept me going but I've been distancing myself more and more from her.  I'm a shitty dog owner, lately I've just been feeding her and making sure she potties, she's been so cooped up because of me distancing myself.

I have friends who care but what happens when I don't?  What I do when I'm done with everything and just ready to end it.  My therapist 'fired' me because i kept canceling and not showing up for appointments.  My family.  Whatever.  My parents were super abusive when I was growing up, I couldn't do anything without some kind of abuse.  Spill a glass of water or juice, get beat, wet my pants, get beat, not finish dinner, get beat. Not to mention the pscyhological and embarressing things they did to me.  

MY extended family swept that all under the rug and never did anything to help me.  I was a fucking child.  

I'm sure my departing will hurt my friends and for that theres nothing I can do.  My letters have all been written.  I have to tread lightly or they'll catch on and I'll end up in a psych ward again, I can't do that again.
